review: With the release of the new Intervalo, the expansion of the blade lineage team has occurred with the addition of Ishmael and new Meursault E.G.O. With it, Mentor finally became less dependent on his blade lineage allies and became a perfect addition to his new teammate. Let’s look into her kit. Starting off with her 4 unique status: - Mook Workshop - Ye - Mainly used to activate S3-2. By itself, this effect provides up to 1 Dmg Up at 10 stacks, up to 3 Haste at 15 stacks, and makes you lose clash with clashable guards. This effect is needed for her second passive, which makes her use s2-2 one clashable guard’s clash lose while she has three Haste. - Bearing of a Salsu - Gives Offense Level based on stacks, 2 Poise Potency on hit. This status can go up to 3 stacks and loses one upon Blade Lineage ally death. Pretty ironic when she doesn’t even count as a Salsu. - Swordplay of the Homeland
